x: Les Coy pulled away to win in the last 600 with Alistair Horton four seconds behind. It won't be long before Alistair has the break through he deserves.

Without John Gladwin and Mark Sinclair or John Searle and with Olly Foote not yet able to score for us it was left to the 'old firm' of Paton, Richley and North to form the spear-head of our scoring four with Alistair Horton rising to the occasion with an excellent run to close our team in.
On the Country, our Junior Team of Alistair Horton, Stuart Paton, Paul Richley and Mark Waller retained the Junior Team Race in the Surrey Country C.C.
